subject: [Invite] Physical AI Panel @ AWS Loft 04/15
text:
Hey [NAME],

Hope all's well! We're hosting an intimate Physical AI event with our
investors from Next47 on April 15th at the AWS Loft in SF (capping
attendance to 40), and we'd love for you to join if you're interested / can
make it!

It'll run from 5:30-8:30pm, kicking off with a panel discussion on Physical
AI - hearing perspectives on building, scaling, and investing in the space.
Panelists include Heads of AI from Skydio, Zoox, Archetype AI, Intrinsic
ai, our Co-Founder [SENDER], and moderated by Colton Dempsey, Partner @ Next47.

Following the panel, we've planned an informal networking session with
drinks and food - bringing together technical leaders from Helm ai, Blue
River, 1X, Nuro, UnitX, Figure AI, Siemens Robotics, Waymo, Zipline, etc.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up ($50M Series B)
focused on streamlining data curation, annotation, workflow management, and
model evaluation in one platform.

Should be a great evening - let me know if you're available & I'll reserve
you a spot / send over an invite.

subject: Overlap with Standard AI | Scaling Spatial AI at [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw that you used to work at Standard AI (a client of ours) and that since working at [COMPANY], your team is looking to hire CV and Data infrastructure engineers as well as the Head of Engineering - thought it was a good time to reach out now scale CV / Data management is top of mind. I work in the CV / AI Retail team at Encord (focused on data curation, annotation & model evaluation, ~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we're working with a few of your peers (Standard AI, Scandit, Focal Systems etc) to develop and maintain robust and scalable systems for processing large-scale computer vision systems and image datasets, as well as model evaluation.

Keen to get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next with our leadership team? I'm wide open your Friday morning.

subject: Fine-tuning 4NE-1
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

I lead the Robotics team here at Encord and we've been working with a few of your peers (Including 1X & Figure AI) to support the fine-tuning of their VLMs / VLAs - particularly focused on using Agentic workflows to accelerate generate caption diversity within HITL verification flows. 

Have been following Neura and the success of 4NE-1 for some time & was wondering if this was something that's now top of mind following the Series B earlier this year?

Would love to swap notes on what we're seeing in the space. Let me know if you're be open to a 30-minute chat later next week? Wednesdays or Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Encord / Lin (Wyze)
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well. Just read through a few articles highlighting Wyze's
latest AI innovations-I love the descriptive alerts feature. I couldn't
help but notice some overlaps with a few teams we are working with in the

I'd love to hear about some of the initiatives you have on the roadmap and
explore how we may be of help. Do you have time this week or next for a
quick intro? I'm free Friday after 11:00 AM if that works for you.
